in_hebrew.name: Griz
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Strength of Bear
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Griz הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'grypos' meaning 'curved like a goat's horn' or 'hooked nose'. The name Griz may have evolved to symbolize the strength and power of a bear.

in_greek.name: Griz
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strength of Bear
in_greek.long_meaning: Griz είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'grypos' meaning 'curved like a goat's horn' or 'hooked nose'. The name Griz may have evolved to symbolize the strength and power of a bear.

in_latin.name: Griz
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strength of Bear
in_latin.long_meaning: Griz est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'grypos' meaning 'curved like a goat's horn' or 'hooked nose'. The name Griz may have evolved to symbolize the strength and power of a bear.
